name: Animate Your Name
concept: Clicking one letter starts its own action; the green flag restores the starting scene.
normal: Click C, D, and E to explore the working examples. Add one sprite-click reaction to O, using an adjacent script as your example. Then draw or choose letters for your own name and keep one working reaction per letter. No loops are needed.
hard: Choose another reaction: sound, size, turning, dialogue, a backdrop, or a color effect. Add one effect at a time; a single working addition is enough before trying another.
check: Click one letter at a time and explain its event and action. Click E twice: its size grows each time. Press the flag: positions, direction, size, color effects, dialogue and the Day backdrop return to their starting state. Test your own name the same way.

name: Two Arrows
normal: Run the four-block example. Predict what each arrow does, then change the distance from 10 to 20.
hard: Make left and right move different distances and explain the result.
check: Press each arrow separately and explain the event and action blocks.

name: Add a Third Direction
concept: Reuse a familiar pattern for a new input.
normal: Left and right already work. Add an up-arrow event that changes y by 10.
hard: Add down movement and a Space event that returns the sprite to the center.
check: Left and right change x; up and down change y.

name: Click Reactions
concept: Different events can control different sprites.
normal: Click the blue robot to see its color change. Give the orange robot its own click reaction.
hard: Add a key event that changes size, then a green-flag script that resets size and effects.
check: Each robot reacts to its own click without changing the other robot.

name: Robot Dress-Up
concept: A reset restores the starting scene.
normal: The hat is a worked example. Complete the badge's green-flag reset and click-to-glide scripts. Drag it first, read x and y, then add the motion block.
hard: Complete the boots too. Use front/back layers deliberately and compare go to with glide.
check: Dress the robot, press the flag, and confirm every accessory returns to its starting position.

name: Day and Night
concept: The stage can respond to events too.
normal: Space already changes the backdrop. Add a green-flag event that switches to Day.
hard: Make a sprite react when Night starts, using the backdrop event.
check: Change the scene several times, then restart. Day should always be first.

name: Robot Conversation
normal: The blue robot introduces itself and broadcasts reply. Add a receive-reply script to the orange robot and make it say a response.
hard: Send another message for a third turn without overlapping speech.
check: The second robot answers only after the first robot finishes.

name: Repeat Dance
concept: Repeat groups a fixed number of actions.
normal: The blue robot already dances with a repeat loop. Give the orange robot its own repeat dance.
hard: Add costume changes and test how wait changes the rhythm.
check: Count the turns and predict the final direction before running.

name: Edge Patrol
concept: Forever keeps a behavior running until Stop.
normal: A robot already moves and bounces. Add a short wait inside its forever loop so its patrol is easier to watch.
hard: Add a second patrolling robot or switch costumes inside the loop.
check: Use Stop to end the patrol, and the flag to restart from the center.

name: Maze Checkpoint
concept: If tests whether a condition is true.
normal: The arrows and wall check work. Add a green-flag go-to script returning the robot to (-180, -120). Reach the gold goal.
hard: Add a touching-Goal condition that says a success message. Combine two conditions with and or or.
check: Touch the purple wall to return to the start; restarting must return there too.

name: Click and Count
concept: A variable remembers a changing value.
normal: Blue adds one point when clicked. Make orange add one point too, using the same Score variable.
hard: Make one sprite worth two points and explain why Score resets to zero on the flag.
check: Press the flag, click blue twice and orange once, and check your predicted score.

name: Build Your Collection Game
concept: Combine events, repetition, conditions, and variables.
normal: The player moves and Score resets. Inside the token's touching-Player condition, add change Score by 1 before it goes to a random position.
hard: Add a win condition, a second item, or another scene. Sketch the rule first and keep a working checkpoint.
check: Collect three tokens, check the score, then restart and confirm the player and score reset.
